name: Per-vertex edge classification for view-independent cell projection
definition: A technique to avoid defects in per-vertex classification during rasterization by ensuring at least one vertex on an edge has the correct classification of the second face sharing the edge, affecting the whole edge during rasterization.
summary: Per-vertex edge classification for view-independent cell projection avoids rasterization artifacts by using vertex attributes to propagate visibility across shared edges, differing from viewpoint-dependent subdivision methods.
